*TEDxColegio Nueva Granada, Bogotá, March 2025.*

Every decision framework breaks down under complexity: consequences are unpredictable, intentions are self-serving, and rules are rigid. Drawing on chess, this talk argues that learning to navigate uncertainty is what actually decides outcomes.
